landing.heroSubtitle: Track parallel learning goals, identify knowledge gaps with the Feynman Technique, and build unbreakable daily habits with Streaks & EXP rewards.
landing.problemSubtitle: Most people give up not due to lack of effort, but due to poor tracking systems and passive learning habits.
landing.traditionalPoint1: Passive reading without testing deep comprehension.
landing.traditionalPoint2: Overwhelmed when juggling multiple skills simultaneously.
landing.traditionalPoint3: Lack of daily accountability and habit rewards.
landing.multitrackPoint1: Force yourself to explain topics simply to uncover knowledge gaps.
landing.multitrackPoint2: Manage parallel tracks seamlessly without clutter.
landing.multitrackPoint3: Gain EXP, protect 🔥 Streaks & get automated mail reminders.
landing.feynmanTitle: The Feynman Method: Learn by Teaching
landing.feynmanSubtitle: Named after Nobel Prize-winning physicist Richard Feynman. True mastery comes from explaining complex ideas in simple terms.
landing.feynmanStep1Desc: Select a specific topic you want to master within your track.
landing.feynmanStep2Desc: Write a check-in note as if teaching it to a 12-year-old child.
landing.feynmanStep3Desc: Spot where you stumble or use jargon. Those are your knowledge gaps.
landing.feynmanStep4Desc: Re-read source material and refine your explanation until effortless.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything You Need to Master Self-Learning
landing.featureFeynmanDesc: Log daily check-ins by explaining concepts as simply as if teaching a beginner. Knowledge gaps (Gaps) surface immediately so you can fix them.
landing.featureStreakDesc: Earn EXP points on every check-in, level up your profile, and unlock prestigious Badges to maintain unbreakable momentum.
landing.featureParallelDesc: Track multiple independent goals (English, Coding, Fitness) simultaneously without confusion.
landing.featureEmailDesc: Our 8 PM daily scheduler scans inactive tracks (>24h) and sends a summary email to protect your Streak.
landing.featureSocialDesc: Share your 🔥 Streak directly to Facebook & X to build public accountability and inspire peers.
landing.workflowStep1Desc: Define target goals, Milestones, and key Concepts.
landing.workflowStep2Desc: Log daily progress and explain concepts in plain English.
landing.workflowStep3Desc: Earn EXP points, increase Level, and maintain habit Streaks.
